verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents parallel automation primitives — delegating work to parallel sub-agents (delegate_task), running one agent per workspace across many worktrees supervised from one tab, and scheduling recurring prompts — which suggest some capacity to run work across multiple items concurrently. However, there is no direct evidence of a bulk-operations feature (e.g., batch-editing, bulk deleting/tagging chats or files, or applying an action across many selected items at once) in the UI or API. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-select/batch-action UI or API for operating on many items simultaneously, and any hands-on or docs confirmation of such a feature working at scale.
